rows.text: with `b` = `rcx`, `d` = `r8`, `q` = `r9`, `f` = dword [d] and the fifth and sixth arguments `P` and `E`: `x` = (dword [q] + 0xF) AND ~0xF when `f` has bit `0x2` (else 0), plus word [rdx+0x62] when bit `0x4`, plus dword [d+0x38] when bit `0x8`; `n1`, `n2` = how many of the dword [q+0x10] AND 0x7FFFFFFF 24-byte entries at qword [q+0x18], and of the dword [d+0x18] AND 0x7FFFFFFF ones at qword [d+0x20], give non-zero from `005FD5F0`; with k = n2 + 2 + (dword [d+0x28] AND 0x7FFFFFFF) + n1 (32-bit), `S` = ((0x10 if k is at most 1 unsigned, else 8(k - 1) + 0x10) + 0xF) AND ~0xF; when `00600B30(b, S + x, dword [d+8] AND 0x7FFFFFFF)` returns 0 in `al` calls `b`'s vtable slot +0x10; when `f` has bit `0x1` stores at qword [P] qword [b+0xA0] if non-zero, else 0 when qword [b+0x98] or qword [b+0xA8] is null, else `00604750(those two, qword [b+0x20], b)` also stored at [b+0xA0]; when bit `0x2` stores `00602A40(b, q)` at qword [P+8]; then with `e` = qword [b+0x30]: when qword [b+0x38] + S is at most `e` (unsigned) stores the old qword [b+0x38] at [E] and advances it by S; else with `r` = qword [b+0x28], the same with `r` when r + S is at most `e`, otherwise qword [b+0x38] = r and qword [E] = 0

with `o` = `rcx` and `m` = `r8`: stores `a` = `00600120(m)` at qword [o+0x78]; when `d` = qword [o+0x10] is non-null and dword [qword [a+8] + 0x10] and dword [qword [d+8] + 0x10] agree in their low 31 bits, copies dword [qword [d+8]] bytes from qword [d+8] to qword [a+8] by `00861EBA`; stores `0018D240(m, s)` at qwords [o+0x60], [o+0x68] and [o+0x70] for s = `00D62E18` "FocusPlaneDistance", `00D62E30` "FocusRange" and `00D62E40` "FocusBlurRange"; when `k` = dword [o+0x30] AND 0x7FFFFFFF is non-zero stores qword [o+0x78] at qword [qword [o+0x38]] (k above 1) or qword [o+0x38] (k = 1); takes `t1` = `0018D240(m, 00D62BB0 "PointClampSampler")` and `t2` = `0018D240(m, 00D62E50 "LinearClampSampler")`; for each non-null `t` of them, with `B` = qword [qword [o+0x78] + 8] and the stack record (0x47, `02D34718` for t1 or `02D35140` for t2, 0): returns 3 when (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) + word [t+0x10] is above dword [B] (unsigned) or word [t+0x10] is below 4, else copies (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) bytes of the record (not limited to its 24 bytes) to B + word [t+0x10] by `00861EBA`; returns 0

with `p` = `rcx` and `c` = `rdx`: returns 0 when byte [p+0x60] is 0, and `0065CD60(p, c)` when that is non-zero; copies the dwords at +0x84..+0x98 to +0xF4..+0x108, at +0xA0..+0xA8 to +0x110..+0x118 and at +0xC0, +0xC4 to +0x120, +0x124; calls `006582B0`, `00657F70`, `006580D0` and `00653CE0` with (p, c), results ignored; then for i below dword [p+0x80] (unsigned, re-read), when `t` = qword [p+0x280] is non-null, with a stack float `f` = 1.0 for i = 0 else 0, `n` = word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF, `o` = word [t+0x10] and `B` = qword [qword [p+0x58] + 8]: returns 3 when n + o is above dword [B] (unsigned) or `o` is below 4, else copies `n` bytes from &f (n not limited to 4) to B + o by `00861EBA`; and, whether or not `t` is null, calls `00657D60`, `00657A20`, `00657BC0` and `006508C0` with (p, c) in each step, results ignored; returns 0

with `p` = `rcx`, `c` = `rdx`, `Q` = qword [p+0x58] (re-read at each use) and a stack record `s` (qword type, qword `02D34718`, qword value): returns 0 when byte [p+0x60] is 0, and `0065CD60(p, c)` when non-zero; when `t` = qword [p+0x1B8] is non-null, with s = (0x4D, 02D34718, qword [p+0x140]) and `B` = qword [Q+8]: returns 5 when byte [t+2] is not 0x4D, 3 when (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) + word [t+0x10] is above dword [B] (unsigned) or word [t+0x10] is below 4, else copies (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) bytes of `s` (not limited to its 24 bytes) to B + word [t+0x10] by `00861EBA`; then for (qword [p+0x1D0], qword [p+0x150]) and (qword [p+0x1E0], qword [p+0x158]) whose first is non-null calls `0065CC90(qword [Q+8], first, &s)` with s = (0x43, 02D34718, second), returning a non-zero result; stores `02D36EE0` at qword [c+0x80] and returns `006007B0(c, qword [Q], qword [Q+8], dword [p+0x6C] >> 2, dword [p+0x70] >> 2, 1)`

with `p` = `rcx`, `c` = `rdx`, `Q` = qword [p+0x58] (re-read at each use) and a stack record `s` (qword type, qword `02D34718`, qword value): returns 0 when byte [p+0x60] is 0, and `0065CD60(p, c)` when non-zero; when `t` = qword [p+0x190] is non-null, with s = (0x4E, 02D34718, qword [p+0x138]) and `B` = qword [Q+8]: returns 5 when byte [t+2] is not 0x4E, 3 when (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) + word [t+0x10] is above dword [B] (unsigned) or word [t+0x10] is below 4, else copies (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) bytes of `s` (not limited to its 24 bytes) to B + word [t+0x10] by `00861EBA`; when qword [p+0x198] is non-null returns `001B81B0(qword [Q+8], it, &s)` with s = (0x42, 02D34718, qword [p+0x128]) when non-zero; when qword [p+0x1C0] is non-null returns `0065CC90(qword [Q+8], it, &s)` with s = (0x43, 02D34718, qword [p+0x148]) when non-zero; stores `02D36F00` at qword [c+0x80] and returns `006007B0(c, qword [Q], qword [Q+8], dword [p+0x74] >> 2, dword [p+0x78] >> 2, dword [p+0x7C] >> 2)`

with `p` = `rcx`, `c` = `rdx`, `Q` = qword [p+0x58] (re-read at each use) and a stack record `s` (qword type, qword `02D34718`, qword value): returns 0 when byte [p+0x60] is 0, and `0065CD60(p, c)` when non-zero; for (qword [p+0x1D8], qword [p+0x150]) and then (qword [p+0x1E8], qword [p+0x158]) whose first `t` is non-null, with s = (0x4E, 02D34718, second) and `B` = qword [Q+8]: returns 5 when byte [t+2] is not 0x4E, 3 when (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) + word [t+0x10] is above dword [B] (unsigned) or word [t+0x10] is below 4, else copies (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) bytes of `s` (not limited to its 24 bytes) to B + word [t+0x10] by `00861EBA`; when qword [p+0x198] is non-null returns `001B81B0(qword [Q+8], it, &s)` with s = (0x42, 02D34718, qword [p+0x128]) when non-zero; stores `02D36E80` at qword [c+0x80] and returns `006007B0(c, qword [Q], qword [Q+8], dword [p+0x74] >> 2, dword [p+0x78] >> 2, dword [p+0x7C] >> 2)`

with `p` = `rcx`, `w` = `edx`, `h` = `r8d` and `m` = dword [p+0x4114]: the targets are qwords [p+0x41D8] to [p+0x41E8] for m = 1, [p+0x41F0] to [p+0x4208] for m = 2 and [p+0x4210] to [p+0x4238] for m = 3; calls `00650500(target, w, h)` on each in order and returns the first non-zero result; when all return 0, or for any other `m`, returns `00650D40(p, w, h)`

with `p` = `rcx`, `w` = `edx` and `h` = `r8d`, for each slot qword [p+0x80], [p+0x88], [p+0x90] and [p+0x98] in order: returns 1 when the slot is null, its byte +8 is non-zero or `t` = qword [slot] is null; when dword [t+0x28] is not `w` or dword [t+0x2C] is not `h`: when `00625F00(t)` returns non-zero in `al`, returns `0062BCB0(t)` when that is non-zero; returns `0060DD70(t, w, h, qword [t], 0)` when non-zero; returns 0 after the fourth slot

with `p` = `rcx`, `W` = `edx`, `H` = `r8d` and C(s, a, b): returns 1 when the slot s is null, its byte +8 is non-zero or `t` = qword [s] is null; when dword [t+0x28] is not `a` or dword [t+0x2C] is not `b`, returns `0062BCB0(t)` when `00625F00(t)` returns non-zero in `al` and that is non-zero, then returns `0060DD70(t, a, b, qword [t], 0)` when non-zero: for j = 0 to 2 with a = W >> (2 + j) and b = H >> (2 + j) (unsigned) applies C to qword [p+0xA0+8j] and then qword [p+0xB8+8j]; then applies C to qword [p+0xD0] with W >> 1 and H >> 1; returns 0

corrections.why: byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: x, n1/n2 counting loops (stride 0x18, 005FD5F0 non-zero, masked counts), the 00600B30 call and slot +0x10 fallback, the P/P+8 stores, and the bump/rewind of qword [b+0x38] against qword [b+0x30] (unsigned jbe/ja) all check out; P/E are the 5th/6th stack args. Defect: 'k is at most 1' is 'cmp eax, 1; jbe' - unsigned. k = n2 + 2 + (dword [d+0x28] AND 0x7FFFFFFF) + n1 can wrap past 0x7FFFFFFF, and a signed reading would send such k to the 0x10 branch while the code computes 8(k-1)+0x10. Added 'unsigned'; two small trims keep it at 1196 chars.

byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: Body checks out (00600120(m) at +0x78; the low-31-bit xor compare then memcpy(qword [a+8], qword [d+8], dword [qword [d+8]]); the three 0018D240 strings verified as FocusPlaneDistance/FocusRange/FocusBlurRange and PointClampSampler/LinearClampSampler; k > 1 / k = 1 store target; ja/jb unsigned bound checks; 00861EBA = VCRUNTIME140 memcpy). Defect: the stack record is three qwords at rsp+0x20 (24 bytes) but the copy length is word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF with no cap, so the copy can read past the record; the sibling row 00657870 states the same fact for its 4-byte float ('n not limited to 4'), this one does not.

byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: Body checks out (0065CD60 gate, the 6+3+2 dword copies, four calls with results ignored, loop i < dword [p+0x80] re-read with jbe/jb, t re-read each step, f = 1.0 only at i = 0 in the rcx home slot, ja/jb bounds, uncapped n copy). Defect: scope. The four calls 00657D60/00657A20/00657BC0/006508C0 run at 006579BF on every iteration, including when t is null (je 006579BF); after 'when t ... is non-null, ...: ...; and calls ...' they read as part of the t block. Made explicit.

byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: Body checks out (gate, s = (0x4D, 02D34718, qword [p+0x140]) built before the byte [t+2] test, 5/3 returns with jbe/jae, the two 0065CC90 pairs with type 0x43, 02D36EE0 at [c+0x80], 006007B0 args with shr 2 and 1, result returned either way). Defects: (1) Q is not read once - qword [p+0x58] is re-loaded before every use (00657A73, 00657B0D, 00657B49, 00657B81), including after the 00861EBA and 0065CC90 calls; (2) s is 24 bytes at rsp+0x30 but the copy length (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF) is uncapped, so the copy can read past it (the sibling row 00657870 states this for its float).

byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: Body checks out (gate, s = (0x4E, 02D34718, qword [p+0x138]), 5/3 returns, 001B81B0 with (0x42, qword [p+0x128]), 0065CC90 with (0x43, qword [p+0x148]), 02D36F00, 006007B0 with dwords +0x74/+0x78/+0x7C shr 2). Defects: (1) qword [p+0x58] is re-loaded at every use (00657C13, 00657CAD, 00657CE9, 00657D16), including after calls, not read once as 'Q = qword [p+0x58]' implies; (2) the 24-byte stack record is copied with an uncapped length (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF).

byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: Body checks out (gate, the (0x1D8, 0x150) then (0x1E8, 0x158) pairs with type 0x4E and the 5/3 returns, 001B81B0 with (0x42, qword [p+0x128]), 02D36E80, 006007B0 with dwords +0x74/+0x78/+0x7C shr 2). Defects: (1) qword [p+0x58] is re-loaded at every use (0065812B, 006581B3, 00658232, 0065825F), including after the memcpy and 001B81B0 calls, not read once; (2) the 24-byte stack record is copied with an uncapped length (word [t+0x12] AND 0x1FFF).
